adjudication.rationale: The diff shows at line 170 in EventManager.ts: `credentialId: isCalendarType ? result.credentialId : undefined`. This means when `isCalendarType` is false (i.e., for video meetings), the credentialId is set to undefined. Looking at the reference creation logic, video meeting references would have undefined credentialId. In handleCancelBooking.ts, the deletion logic checks `if (credentialId)` before finding credentials to delete video meetings. If credentialId is undefined/missing, the video meeting deletion would be skipped, leaving remote video meetings active. This is a real bug where video meeting credential associations are lost.
